A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the damage thresholds of MgF2 and CaF2 are close and are 2.5–3.0 times higher than the damage threshold of LiF.
the damage thresholds of the investigated fluoride crystals for λ = 193, 248, and 351 nm are comparable with those of the crystals for λ =1064 and 532 nm.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the damage thresholds of the crystals are not affected by the focal spot size, which is a very important result.
the damage thresholds for the crystals are higher than the thresholds of the corresponding glasses by 2.5 to 3 times.
the damage threshold for a 70-ns laser pulse of λ = 248-nm KrF laser radiation in a 1600-μm focal spot is 1.3 GW/cm2 for MgF2, 0.9 GW/cm2 for CaF2, 1.1 GW/cm2 for KF, and 0.8 GW/cm2 for NaF.
